en.title: ei in trei (three)
en.summary: This item illustrates the Romanian diphthong ei as found in the word trei.

sections.title: The sound ei
paragraphs: The letters ei sound like the sound /ej/. You hear this in the word (trei) /trej/, which means three. This letter combination makes two different sounds in Romanian words.

sections.title: Mouth movements
paragraphs: For the first sound, start with your mouth half open and your tongue forward. Glide quickly into a short, high tongue position. For the second sound, make the first vowel clearly, and then make a full second vowel. You can feel your voice box vibrate continuously throughout both sounds.

sections.title: Reading the letters
paragraphs: In one syllable, the letters make the sound /ej/, as in (lei) /lej/. Across two syllables, each letter has its own beat, making the sound /e.i/. You hear this split sound in the word (atei) /aˈte.i/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not make the long English sound heard in the word say. Keep the first part crisp, and glide rapidly. When the vowels sit in separate syllables, do not blend them together into one syllable.
